name: Layered and positional audio
body: Dean (2026-11-17): lets do audio. A proper audio system for the grounded action-adventure: a mixer with buses, 3D sources panned and attenuated against the camera listener, crossfading ambience layers, reactive music layers, footsteps by surface for the player and partner, UI sounds. All sounds generated procedurally (no licensed assets); testable headless with SDL's dummy driver.
